quotes.text: Get everything you need to pay, get paid, and manage your money in 40+ currencies — all in one place.
Your money is held in a safeguarded, separate account.
Send, spend and manage your money across 150+ countries and earn a game-changing return.
74% of transfers arrive in under 20 seconds, 95% in a day.
Join over 18.9 million people sending money abroad — with fees as low as 0.1% .

Your money is safeguarded, and held completely separate from ours, so it's available to you all the time.
